build_infersent_model: build an InferSent model with GloVe embeddings and LSTM encoder for sentence embeddings
create_batcher_embeddings: create a batcher function that encodes sentence batches into fixed-size embedding vectors
test_infersent_senteval: test the InferSent model on 25 SentEval transfer tasks including STS and sentiment analysis
run_senteval_evaluation: run SentEval evaluation with a configured classifier and kfold cross-validation on transfer tasks
prepare_infersent_vocab: prepare InferSent vocabulary from sample sentences without tokenization for embedding generation
